players.product: intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) individualized neoantigen therapy, jointly developed with Merck

quarterly_data.signal: September 30, 2026 release: Moderna said its infectious disease franchise now includes five approved vaccines following the recent U.S. FDA approval of its seasonal flu vaccine and the European Commission marketing authorization of its seasonal flu plus COVID combination vaccine, and that it is preparing for the potential launch and scale-up of intismeran autogene (jointly developed with Merck) following positive Phase 3 results while continuing to advance a broader oncology portfolio.
